other_conditions: Regularly employed candidates are not eligible; women scientists temporarily employed in research or academia may apply but must leave the earlier assignment if the fellowship is approved
Eligible only for women scientists holding a Ph.D. or equivalent degree (MD, MS, MDS, etc.) in basic or applied science
A career break is not mandatory but applicants with a break are encouraged to apply
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹55,000 plus HRA, an annual research grant of ₹2 lakh, equipment up to ₹3 lakh and institutional overhead charges
